supported_claim: The strict six-cohort gene-level meta-analysis yielded no STABLE PE genes under the preregistered rule.
maximum_allowed_wording: No stable universal individual-gene PE signature was identified under the frozen criteria.
key_limitation: Cross-platform effect heterogeneity and incomplete covariates

supported_claim: Corrected pregnancy-level analysis localized PE-associated programs to selected placental cell states in Admati.
maximum_allowed_wording: PE-associated interferon and related programs were localized to selected cell states in the corrected primary scRNA analysis.
prohibited_overclaim: These cell states were independently validated in bulk placenta.
key_limitation: Primary localization largely depends on one scRNA dataset

supported_claim: Yang LOPE provided partial directional support for placental-stromal interferon themes.
maximum_allowed_wording: The stromal interferon theme had partial independent LOPE scRNA directional support.
prohibited_overclaim: All receiver cell-type localizations replicated independently.
key_limitation: n=3 versus 3 and conservative mapping; SCT/Hofbauer limitations

supported_claim: Five receiver modules showed bulk tissue-level directional support; none met robust module criteria.
maximum_allowed_wording: Single-cell-defined programs showed limited directional support across independent bulk cohorts.
prohibited_overclaim: Hofbauer or SCT localization was validated by bulk.

supported_claim: Independent hUC-MSC datasets defined 214 robust transcriptomic S1/S2 sender candidates.
maximum_allowed_wording: A donor-aware, cross-dataset transcriptomic sender ligand universe was frozen.
prohibited_overclaim: All 214 ligands are secreted proteins or therapeutic mediators.
key_limitation: Transcript abundance is not secretion or functional exposure

supported_claim: Licensing responses were described within donor×passage strata.
maximum_allowed_wording: Inflammatory licensing altered availability of some sender transcripts in a donor/passage-dependent manner.
key_limitation: Only two donors; licensing is context, not efficacy

supported_claim: Blinded integration identified receptor and target compatibility between frozen sender and receiver arms.
maximum_allowed_wording: Many frozen ligands were mechanistically compatible with PE receiver programs.

supported_claim: Generic signed priors yielded 17 Tier A candidates, with mixed direction retained.
maximum_allowed_wording: Seventeen candidates satisfied a generic-signed-prior reversal rule.
prohibited_overclaim: The 17 are predicted therapeutic rescue factors.
key_limitation: Generic network propagation is not empirical placental reversal

supported_claim: Fifteen of 17 candidates were detected in hUC/WJ-MSC EV protein resources.
maximum_allowed_wording: Direct EV protein evidence supports extracellular-source plausibility for 15 candidates.
prohibited_overclaim: The proteins are soluble conditioned-medium factors.
key_limitation: EV and soluble compartments are distinct

supported_claim: ENPP1 alone satisfied the unchanged TRIANGULATED_HIGH_PRIORITY rule after protein-source correction.
maximum_allowed_wording: ENPP1 emerged as the only candidate satisfying the prespecified multi-domain triangulation rule.
prohibited_overclaim: ENPP1 mediates hUC-MSC therapy in PE.
key_limitation: EV-only source, non-placental perturbation, mixed receiver directions, no PE experiment

supported_claim: ENPP1 is the mechanically triangulated lead hypothesis.
maximum_allowed_wording: ENPP1 is the leading experimentally testable communication hypothesis emerging from the frozen framework.
prohibited_overclaim: ENPP1 is a validated therapeutic factor, protective mechanism, or established PE target.
key_limitation: Causality, placental exposure, direction and efficacy are untested

supported_claim: PROGRAM_MODULE_10 had zero target-compatible sender axes under the frozen rule.
maximum_allowed_wording: No frozen sender connection was identified for the SCT oxidative-phosphorylation receiver.
prohibited_overclaim: External mitochondrial biology establishes a Phase4A Module10 axis.
key_limitation: Frozen negative result cannot be rescued by later literature
